name: Blood Artist in both triggers and did_not_trigger
description: Claude contradicts itself by listing Blood Artist in both triggers (correctly) and did_not_trigger. The validator should resolve the contradiction by trusting the trigger list.

Blood Artist.name: Blood Artist
Blood Artist.oracle_text: Whenever Blood Artist or another creature dies, target player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

triggers.trigger_text: Whenever Blood Artist or another creature dies
triggers.resulting_effects: Target player loses 1 life and Alice gains 1 life

did_not_trigger.reason: Blood Artist only triggers when creatures you control die.
Viscera Seer has an activated ability, not a triggered ability.

expected_after_validation.notes: Blood Artist removed from did_not_trigger (contradiction with triggers). Viscera Seer removed from did_not_trigger (no triggered ability in oracle text — it's an activated ability).
